verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Atlas issues founders equity with customizable vesting, cliff and start date, and files 83(b) elections for all C-corp founders. The paperwork uses templates developed with Cooley LLP and is available in the Dashboard's Documents tab. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of IP assignment agreements, detail on the founder stock purchase mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the post-incorporation paperwork is correct.
